title: 2019-09-04 Meeting notes - Evaluation of GitHub M2 Setup
content:
Date

Attendees


Goal

Goal is to have an IPEX DevOps setup with GitHub and Jira that has been tested internally and that a pilot project can implement.

Discussion items

TimeItemWhoNotes



CBF GitHubName

We need to be able to compare Bitbucket with GitHub Enterprise. Decide on features that is included in basic IPEX DevOps setup.

How to get access to GitHub. We have ha meeting with the M2 project and discussed their setup of GitHub to Jira integration. INGKA GitHub do not require that developers has an IKEA account. This makes it easy to on board new members. We need to investigate how we on board to CBF account. Is IKEA domain account required. When someone leaves project it must be secure and easy. Make sure that history is not lost. 

Experience from M2 project is that they use a minimal integration to Jira using the Jira GitHub plugin and web hooks. Commit is linked to Jira issue and actions in GitHub change Jira status.

Test to install Jira Github plugin


PR


There should be a link in Jira issue to PR

PR should list changed files

Possible to view changes in PR

Comments and discussions regarding PR available


CI/CD

Azure DevOps build pipeline / GitHub actions / Bitbucket pipelines

Must be possible to visualize deployment pipeline. It should be possible to show which environment a change has been deployed to.

Action items

1 complete  Get access to CBF GitHub EA account 2 complete  Get access to Jira 3 complete  First Setup of  GitHub <-> Jira verify that it fulfills what projects are doing today
